name: Customer Directory
description: A shared team directory of customer contacts with a log of calls, emails and meetings per customer
backend_requirements: Access control: require auth for every customer and interaction endpoint, reading included (the directory is shared by all signed-in users); admin endpoints are restricted to the admin account
Customers: any signed-in user may create, update and delete any customer; DELETE /api/customers/:id removes the customer and its interactions permanently

Customer validation: name is a required non-empty string of at most 100 characters; email is required, a valid email address of at most 255 characters, and unique among customers ignoring case (a duplicate answers 409); phone (at most 30 characters), company (at most 100 characters) and notes (at most 2000 characters) are optional

GET /api/customers returns active customers sorted by name; ?query= matches name, email or company case-insensitively, ?company= keeps customers of exactly that company (ignoring case), ?page= and ?page_size= page the result (page_size default 20, at most 100), and total counts every matching customer
PUT /api/customers/:id replaces the customer's fields: name and email are required, and an omitted phone, company or notes is cleared
Every customer in a response carries interaction_count and last_contacted_at (the occurred_at of its latest interaction, null without interactions)

Interactions: POST /api/customers/:id/interactions logs a contact with kind (one of call, email, meeting), a required summary of at most 500 characters and an optional occurred_at (default now) for the signed-in user; GET /api/customers/:id/interactions lists them newest first
Deactivated customers (is_active false) are left out of GET /api/customers and answer 404 on the other customer endpoints; the admin overview still lists them
Errors answer with a JSON object {"detail": "<message>"}: 400 for invalid input, 401 without a valid token, 403 for a non-admin on admin endpoints, 404 for unknown ids, 409 for a duplicate email
frontend_requirements: Visitors see only a sign-in screen with a short description of the directory; every other view is for signed-in users
Sign-in and registration forms that call /api/auth/login and /api/auth/register; keep the token for later requests, show the signed-in username and offer sign-out
Customer list: a table with name, email, phone, company and last contacted date, a search box, a company filter and previous/next paging
Customer detail view: all of the customer's fields with edit and delete actions, its interaction log (kind, summary, date, who logged it) and a form to log a new interaction
Add and edit customer forms that show the API's validation messages next to the form, including the duplicate-email message; delete asks for confirmation first
admin_requirements: Admin overview: every customer, active or not, with total, active and inactive counts
Toggle a customer's active status from the overview

api_endpoints.description: List active customers sorted by name, filtered and paged

query.query: Case-insensitive text matched against name, email and company

api_endpoints.description: Replace a customer's fields (name and email required; an omitted phone, company or notes is cleared)
Delete a customer and its interactions
Interactions with a customer, newest first
Log an interaction with a customer as the signed-in user

data_models.name: Customer
data_models.description: A customer contact; interaction_count and last_contacted_at are computed from its interactions

fields.name: string (required, max 100 chars)
fields.email: string (required, max 255 chars, unique ignoring case)
fields.is_active: boolean (default true; false hides the customer from the non-admin endpoints)

data_models.name: Interaction
data_models.description: One logged call, email or meeting with a customer

fields.customer_id: integer (references Customer.id; deleted with the customer)
fields.user_id: integer (references the signed-in user who logged it)

admin_api_endpoints.description: Admin overview: every customer with counts
